_comment: The text adventure's DEFAULT content pack (content sets R1): one pack concept per mechanic concept the text adventure realises. Each presents that concept and names its text slots (text-library keys in this pack's text layer). The slots are the ones the substrate's contentRoles ask for; what each slot MEANS (which message of the room it becomes) is the substrate's code (textAdventureRoom.js).

text-adventure:object/sword.name: Sword
text-adventure:object/sword.description: A blade keen enough to fell the guardian.

text-adventure:object/swim.name: Swimming
text-adventure:object/swim.description: The knack of swimming, for crossing deep water.

text-adventure:character/guardian.name: Guardian
text-adventure:character/guardian.description: A hulking armoured guardian that bars a passage until it is fought with a sword.

text-adventure:object/water.name: Water
text-adventure:object/water.description: Deep water that floods a passage until it is crossed by swimming.
